instructions:
Presentations.AI for Business creates finished, designed slide decks (PPTX, PDF, or slide images) from a prompt, pasted text, or an outline.

When to use it: the user asks for a presentation, deck, slides, or a pitch, or asks to turn their text into slides. If they share a report, notes, or data without asking for slides, you can suggest a deck, but create one only after they agree: each deck spends credits from their workspace.

Creating a deck:
- `create_presentation` — a prompt, inline text sources, or an outline becomes a finished deck.
  Pass source material as `{"type": "text", "content": ...}` entries in `deck.sources`.
- `get_task` — poll the returned task_id until COMPLETED; pass wait_time (≤60s) and repeat.
  A typical deck takes a few minutes.
- `get_export` — a download URL for the file. It expires after 15 minutes; call again for a fresh one.
- `share_deck` — a public link anyone can open; create one only when the user asks for a link or to share the deck.

To review the structure first, call `create_outline` (it bills its slides, separately from the deck), edit the returned outline, and pass it as `deck.outline` to `create_presentation`. Find a brand with `search_brand_kits` and pass its id as `deck.brand_kit_id`. `whoami` shows the connected account, its plan, and its credit balance.

Manage existing work with `list_decks`, `get_deck`, `list_projects`, `patch_deck` (rename, move, visibility, content version), `delete_deck`, and `create_grant` (share with a person by email).

Conventions:
- All ids are UUIDs; pass ids from earlier results verbatim.
- List tools take page/limit (1-based) and return {data, page, limit, total}.
- Generation runs in the background: poll `get_task` rather than waiting on one call.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Whoami
tools.description:
Show the connected account's email, workspace, role, plan, and credit balance.

Use it when the user asks which account is connected, its plan, or its credits left.

outputSchema.description: The connected account, its workspace, role and plan, and the credit balance.

plan.description: The workspace's plan; it decides which features are available.

tools.name: create_presentation
tools.title: Create Presentation
tools.description:
Create a finished, designed presentation from a prompt, text, or an outline.

Use it when the user asks for a presentation, deck, slides, a pitch, or a
PowerPoint. The deck is saved in the user's Presentations.AI workspace and can
be exported as PPTX, PDF or slide images, or shared by link.

`deck` takes the same fields as `POST /decks`: e.g. `prompt`, `sources`
(`{"type": "text", "content": ...}`), `slide_count`, `audience`,
`level_of_detail`, `deck_purpose`, `brand_kit_id` (find one with
`search_brand_kits`), or an edited `outline` from `create_outline`.
Retrying an identical call returns the same deck; pass a new `request_id` to
generate another copy.

Generation spends credits and takes a few minutes in the background: poll
`task_id` with `get_task`, then fetch the file with `get_export`, or a public
link with `share_deck` when the user asks for one.

deck.description: `POST /decks` input; the outline schema is enforced on submit, not spelled out here.

prompt.description: Topic and instructions for the presentation, or pasted content to build from.

oneOf.description: Inline factual source material supplied directly in the request.

content.description: Factual material to build from; all text sources together are capped at 200,000 characters.

oneOf.description: Reference to a source document previously uploaded through `/files`.

file_id.description: `file_id` from `POST /files`; its extraction must have completed (409 `SOURCES_NOT_READY` otherwise).

sources.description: Inline text and/or references to files uploaded through POST /files.

name.description: Deck name shown in the workspace. Omitted: `deck_title`, else the outline's `documentTitle`, else the generated title.

visibility.description: Who can open the deck. `PROJECT` requires `project_id`.

project_id.description: Project to create the deck in. Required for `PROJECT` visibility; a project-scoped API key must pass its own project.

deck_title.description: Requested presentation title. Alone it is enough to generate from; it also names the deck when `name` is omitted.

outline.description: The `outline` object from `create_outline`, edited as needed. Skips outline generation; cannot be combined with `prompt` or sources.

company.description: Company the deck is about; seeds research and the outline's `companyName` instead of inferring it from the prompt.

creator_role.description: Author's job title; sets background tone and research budget. Omitted: the API key owner's profile role.

model.description: Generation model tier, case-insensitive. A tier above the workspace plan's returns 403 `FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN`.

language.description: Output language as an English name (e.g. `French`); `auto` follows the language of the prompt and sources.

slide_count.description: Slides including the cover, each number 1-50: `N` exact, `N-M` a range, `N+` at least N, `auto` or omitted lets the writer decide. `1` yields one summary slide with no cover.

anyOf.description:
Text density per content item.

BRIEF: label plus at most a short line. STANDARD: one sentence. DETAILED: 1-2
sentences. VERY_DETAILED: 2-3 sentences.

level_of_detail.description: Text density per content item, case-insensitive. Omitted: adapted to the topic and content.

insider_content.description: Private background facts about your organisation. Used where a slide calls for them, never cited; counts toward the plan content limit.

export_format.description: Format of the artifact exported when generation completes.

audience.description: Who the deck is for. Omitted: inferred from the prompt and sources, never asked back (the API run has no questions).

deck_purpose.description: Purpose id from the deck purpose taxonomy: pitch, sales, marketing, strategy, report, training, teaching, coursework, product, research, security, general.

brand_kit_id.description: Style the deck as a brand: an `id` from `GET /brand-kits`. Omitted: no brand kit.

deep_search.description: Consultant-grade research and exhibit slides (paid plans; doubles the deck's per-slide credits). Not applicable to an authored outline.

budget_tier.description: Quality tier: `lite`, `standard` (default) or `premium`, each billed at its own per-slide rate. An API run is always Fast: it never asks questions, at any tier.

missing_data.description: A figure only you hold that nobody gave: `placeholder` leaves a `[DATA NEEDED: …]` marker; `estimate` writes a plausible estimate (recorded as one in the outline's figure check). Omitted: taken from what the prompt asks for ("use only my numbers" leaves markers), else `estimate`.

fidelity.description: How source material is used: `retain` keeps its slides, `condense` keeps its sections and tightens them, `context` builds a new deck from it. Omitted: picked from the request and the material.

narrative.description: Narrative arc the storyline follows (e.g. `answer_first`, `what_why_how`). Omitted: the usual arc for the purpose and audience.

delivery.description: How the deck is shown: `stage` (a big screen), `meeting`, `video` (a call), `read` (sent and read alone) or `print`. Sets the words per slide.

use_case.description: Use case id from the create flow's list; routes the writer persona and the asks.

speaker_notes.description: Write presenter talking points for every slide.

company_domain.description: The company's web domain (e.g. `acme.com`); with `company`, seeds research and the brand lookup.

graphic_types.description: Allow-list of body graphics the writer may use (e.g. `table`, `list`, `diagram`); anything else is redrawn as the closest allowed type.

diagram_subtypes.description: Allow-list of diagram shapes (e.g. `process`, `cycle`) when `diagram` is allowed.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Omitted: retrying an identical request returns the same deck; after a FAILED run, or once that deck is deleted, it starts a new one.

outputSchema.description: A dispatched deck-generation run: the new deck, its task handle, and app link.

status.description: Lifecycle state of an async task: CREATED (queued), RUNNING, then COMPLETED or FAILED.

deck_url.description: Opens the deck in the PresentationsAI app; requires signing in as a member with access. Not a public link: use `share_deck` for one.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get Task
tools.description:
Status of an async task (e.g. a presentation generation).

With wait_time=0, returns an immediate snapshot. With wait_time>0 (capped at
60s), waits until the task reaches COMPLETED/FAILED or the window elapses,
then returns the latest status. Once a generation is COMPLETED, `get_export`
returns its file.

kind.description: Task type — determines which Restate handler to invoke.

tools.name: share_deck
tools.title: Share Deck
tools.description:
Get or create the deck's public share link and return the URL.

Anyone with the link can open the deck, so use it only when the user asks for a
link or to share the deck. Reuses the existing link so the URL is stable; pass
rotate=true to mint a fresh one (the previous URL stops working).

tools.name: create_outline
tools.title: Create Outline
tools.description:
Generate a stateless outline from a prompt and/or extracted files.

No deck, session, or generation request is persisted. Referenced files must belong to the
caller's workspace and have completed extraction before this request.

Bills the outline's slides at the Standard rate (10 credits per slide), once, before it is
returned; an empty balance is a 402. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to retry safely: a key that
already paid is a 409.
